overview: In the wilderness of British Columbia, two hunters are tracked and viciously murdered by Aaron Hallum. Former Special Operations instructor, L.T. Bonham is approached and asked to apprehend Hallum, his former student, who has 'gone rogue' after suffering severe battle stress from his time in Kosovo.
tagline: Some men should not be found.

recs.blurb: An unemployed lingerie buyer convinces her bail bondsman cousin to give her a shot as a bounty hunter. Her first assignment is to track down a former cop on…
A young female FBI agent joins a secret CIA operation to take down a Mexican cartel boss, a job that ends up pushing her ethical and moral values to the limit.
Two researchers in a green alternative energy project are put on the run when they are framed for murder and treason.
The daughter of actor, Laurence Harvey turns away from her career as a Ford model to become a bounty hunter.
A DEA agent investigates the disappearance of a legendary Army ranger drill sergeant and several of his cadets during a training exercise gone severely awry.
An ex-Boer war guerrilla in New Zealand is sent out to bring back a Maori accused of killing a British soldier. Gradually they grow to know and respect one…
An elderly ex-serviceman and widower looks to avenge his best friend's murder by doling out his own form of justice.
Nazi hunter Ezra Lieberman discovers a sinister and bizarre plot to rekindle the Third Reich.
A man is out for justice after a group of corrupt police officers are unable to catch his wife's killer.
A British college student falls for an American student, only to be separated from him when she's banned from the U.S. after overstaying her visa.
Two brothers, on either side of the law, face off over organized crime in Brooklyn during the 1970s.
